name: TCG 2011 (Tengu era, Master Rule 2 baseline)
description: The Master Rule 2 baseline flags plus DUEL_OCG_OBSOLETE_IGNITION, researched and confirmed for TCG play at YCS Toronto (2011-09-17). Historical TCG Ignition Effect Priority remained in force at Toronto; DUEL_OCG_OBSOLETE_IGNITION is retained as a conservative project-policy approximation because no ocgcore flag reproduces the exact historical TCG priority window without a core change. DUEL_TCG_FAST_EFFECT_IGNITION was investigated and deliberately NOT added (it grants a broader post-chain window); DUEL_0_ATK_DESTROYED is omitted because the Rulebook Version 7.2 exception was already in force by March 2011. Synchro and Xyz Monsters are legal; Pendulum/Link do not exist yet.

era.official_ruleset_label: Konami 'OFFICIAL RULEBOOK' Version 8.0 (current as of 2011-07-12, introduction of Xyz Monsters and Master Rule 2 in the TCG)

differences_from_modern.summary: The turn player may activate ignition effects with priority after a summon or chain end, restricted to the Monster Zone (OCG-style condition). RETAINED AS A PROJECT-POLICY APPROXIMATION, not a claim that period sources prove it exact or objectively closest: it correctly grants priority for a Monster-Zone ignition effect after a Summon, but wrongly withholds it for a Graveyard/other-location ignition effect after a Summon, and wrongly grants it after a chain resolves with no Summon at all. Kept as a conservative compatibility compromise; see docs/research/edison-rules.md and docs/research/tengu-format-source-gate.md.
The turn-1 player draws in their first Draw Phase.
Only one Field Spell can be face-up at a time.
A negated Special Summon still counts against 'only once per turn/duel' summon restrictions.
Trigger effects activate when returned to the Main Deck or Extra Deck.
Old oath effect handling: cannot special summon restrictions apply retroactively if an action occurred.

known_gaps.summary: Ignition Effect Priority: no existing ocgcore configuration reproduces the historical September 2011 TCG rule exactly. TCG ignition priority remained in force at YCS Toronto, but current ocgcore couples the OCG obsolete location gate to a broader model and cannot express the exact TCG window without a core change. DUEL_OCG_OBSOLETE_IGNITION is retained as the least-wrong approximation; DUEL_TCG_FAST_EFFECT_IGNITION is deliberately not enabled as it grants an over-broad post-chain window.
Simultaneous Trigger Effect ordering (SEGOC): period rulebooks describe simple two-tier ordering without mandatory/optional splits or non-public zone subtleties. Left unresolved rather than guessed.
Extra Deck size limit for 2011 (15) is entered here from EDOPro MR2 defaults.
